snippet.title: Unprompted - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Unprompted is a guessing game built around interpretation and discovery.

Each carefully curated artwork was created from a hidden prompt. Your task is to uncover it — and, along the way, encounter how the algorithm interprets its own creative process.

The player is presented with images generated through machine-learning systems and types to guess the prompts that may have produced them. Across seven curated galleries and more than 1,500 images, patterns begin to emerge — not just in the images themselves, but in the associations behind them.

▶ Unprompted on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2129130/Unprompted/

▶ Free daily web version:
https://unpromptedgame.com

—
Unprompted is a project by Matt Eshleman.

Images were generated using Craiyon.

Music:
Atmosphere Fragment by Clacksberg  
https://freesound.org/people/Clacksberg/sounds/495747/
